description: This file contains implementation of various functions and classes related to quantization operations in PyTorch's FX (Function Transform) framework. It defines methods for quantizing and dequantizing tensors, handling per-tensor and per-channel quantization, as well as other quantization utilities and meta-methods. It also registers these implementations with a symbolic Library object for FX graph transformations.
